notes.title: Various enhancements
notes.notes:
We've just added some enhancements to Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple...



[u]Windowed mode[/u]

Toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode using ESC.



[u]Steam achievements[/u]

There are now 22 achievements to collect :

[b]Idol of Prosperity - Bronze[/b]
- Collect 500 gems

[b]Idol of Prosperity - Silver[/b]
- Collect 2,500 gems

[b]Idol of Prosperity - Gold[/b]
- Collect 10,000 gems

[b]Idol of Vitality - Bronze[/b]
- Complete 3 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Idol of Vitality - Silver[/b]
- Complete 5 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Idol of Vitality - Gold[/b]
- Complete 10 consecutive levels without dying

[b]Idol of Fate - Bronze[/b]
- Complete 5 consecutive random levels

[b]Idol of Fate - Silver[/b]
- Complete 10 consecutive random levels

[b]Idol of Fate - Gold[/b]
- Complete 15 consecutive random levels

[b]Idol of Enlightenment - Bronze[/b]
- Find 5 hidden runes

[b]Idol of Enlightenment - Silver[/b]
- Find 10 hidden runes

[b]Idol of Enlightenment - Gold[/b]
- Find 20 hidden runes

[b]Idol of Fortitude - Bronze[/b]
- Attempt 20 levels

[b]Idol of Fortitude - Silver[/b]
- Attempt 100 levels

[b]Idol of Fortitude - Gold[/b]
- Attempt 200 levels

[b]Idol of Discovery - Bronze[/b]
- Complete level 10

[b]Idol of Discovery - Silver[/b]
- Complete level 50

[b]Idol of Discovery - Gold[/b]
- Complete level 100

[b]Idol of Endurance - Bronze[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 100 gems

[b]Idol of Endurance - Silver[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 250 gems

[b]Idol of Endurance - Gold[/b]
- Total of survival mode high scores - 500 gems

[b]Idol of Dominion[/b]
- Unlock all other idols

[b]*** IMPORTANT NOTE #1 ***[/b]

Achievements earned during gameplay will be awarded from the idol page when the relevant idol unlocks.

[b]*** IMPORTANT NOTE #2 ***[/b]

There are no achievements in the demo version of the game.



[u]Pricing[/u]

We've also introduced a permanent price reduction.



Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple - Geek Facts
notes.notes:
Here are some geeky facts about Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple...

[list]
[*] Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple contains many references to classic arcade games such as Asteroids, Check Man, Pac-Man, Centipede, Dragon's Lair and Pitfall.  Other pop culture references include The Wizard of Oz, Whac-A-Mole, Little Shop of Horrors, Harry Potter, Red Riding Hood, Indiana Jones and the works of Stieg Larsson.  Can you spot them all?

[*] There is a hidden meaning in the LH Games logo.

[*] You can tickle the spider that lives on the menu screen.

[*] The rune that was used for the hidden rune challenges is an Elder Futhark rune named Dagaz, which represents enlightenment.

[*] One of the game files that we created is named "52656d79".  If you translate this into ASCII it spells "Remy".

[*] The music that plays when the Idol of Dominion is revealed is called "Blood Ritual".
[/list]
